Name: Money Tree
Author: Lefkada
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Add a Money Tree fruit tree in the game. Bears 250 to 2500 gold per day all year round. [/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]You can buy the sapling [/color][/size]
[spoiler][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]at the lvl6 raccoon shop for 10 mossy seeds.[/color][/size][/spoiler]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]The Money Tree act like any other fruit tree. It can stack up to 3 "fruits" but it's money instead.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Download the mod.
2. Download Content Patcher.
3. Extract the zip file in your Stardew Valley mod folder.
4. Play the game. Enjoy your money growing on a tree.[/color]

[b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]
[color=#D4D4D8]You will need Content Patcher to run this mod. [/color]

Manifest.Name: (CP) Money Tree
Manifest.Description: Money don't grows on tree! Now it does.
Manifest.Author: Lef
